messages:
Nina P: Hi team — I converted from contractor to full-time on 2024-03-18 and had a couple quick onboarding questions: 
1) When will my medical/dental start? Is there any chance of retroactive coverage to 3/18?
2) How will PTO be pro-rated for March since it's a partial month?
3) My employee card in the Wallet app says 'not activated' and trying to enter last4 fails. Who do I reach out to for the card?

Jules (People Ops): Congrats on the conversion! Generally benefits are effective the 1st of the month following confirmation, so likely 4/01. Retroactive start to 3/18 is rare but possible if you missed the cutoff — please submit enrollment and attach the conversion HR email; Benefits can review.

Nina P: Where do I upload the HR email when enrolling?

Benefits Team: Use the benefits portal -> Documents -> "Upload Proof". Include a short note with your FT start date and HR confirmation. Send any claims predating the effective date to benefits@redwood.com and we'll evaluate for retro coverage.

Payroll Team: PTO accrual switches at FT start date. For March it's prorated by days in the month, so accrual = monthly rate * (days active in month / days in month). If you want the exact number, tell us your monthly accrual and we can compute it.

Nina P: Monthly accrual is 1.5 days/month. Can you post the figure here so I know how many days I can request off for April?

Payroll Team: Sure — for March you'd get 1.5 * (14/31) = ~0.68 days. April will have the full 1.5 days. We'll DM you the payroll view link so you can verify.

Nina P: Thanks. About the card — error when entering last4 was 'card number mismatch'.

Card Support Bot: Hi Nina — that error usually means the corporate card record and payroll profile don't match. Please try the Wallet -> Company Card -> Activate flow again. If it still errors, reply here and we'll trigger a re-sync and issue a virtual card in the meantime.

Nina P: Tried again. Now says 'activation pending' but no email.

Card Support Bot: I pushed a sync to the provider and regenerated the activation token. You should get a one-time code within 10 minutes. If not received, we'll issue a virtual card now. Would you prefer virtual immediately?

Nina P: Yes please — virtual would be great. Also uploading HR email to benefits now. Thanks everyone for the quick help! :raised_hands:
